board.mythBn: বিদ্যুৎ চোরকে ধরা আমার কাজ নয়, ওটা পুলিশের কাজ।

rounds.promptBn: কোন সংযোগটা বৈধ? মিটার হয়ে আসা ঠিক সংযোগ বাছুন।
safe: Pole → service cable → outdoor meter board with lead seals intact → house
AB cable with a proper service connector → sealed meter → house

traps.what: Hook on the bare LT conductor, thin wire straight into a house
traps.rejectBn: লাইন থেকে হুকিং করে বিদ্যুৎ নেওয়া — ধারা 135-এ চুরি।

traps.what: Magnet stuck on the meter face
traps.rejectBn: মিটারে চুম্বক লাগিয়ে রিডিং প্রভাবিত করা — চুরি।

traps.what: Second wire joined onto the service cable before the meter
traps.rejectBn: মিটারের আগে থেকে (Upstream) সংযোগ নেওয়া — চুরি।

traps.what: Wire loop around the meter from incoming to outgoing
traps.rejectBn: মিটার বাইপাস করা মানে মিটার ট্যাম্পারিং — চুরি।

rounds.promptBn: চুরির তার থেকে আসল বিপদ কোনগুলো? ঠিক ছবি বাছুন।
safe: Loose hook sparking, thatch or wall below catching fire
The lane's DTR overloaded, an HG fuse wire blown, lane dark

traps.what: Neat taped theft joint shown as if safe
traps.rejectBn: চুরির তার-সরঞ্জাম সাধারণত নিম্নমানের, অনিরাপদ — লুজ কানেকশন হয়।

traps.what: Honest neighbours' bulbs bright while hooks run on the line
traps.rejectBn: চুরির ওভারলোড আর ব্রেকডাউনে সৎ গ্রাহকরাই বিদ্যুৎ পান না।

traps.what: Cool, calm DTR with many hooks on its line
traps.rejectBn: অবৈধ সংযোগ ট্রান্সফরমারে অতিরিক্ত, অজানা লোড চাপায়।

rounds.promptBn: কোন এলাকায় বড় চুরির সম্ভাবনা? লক্ষণ বাছুন।
safe: DTR showing overload (HG fuse wire blown, heat shimmer) feeding only a few houses
Few houses on the DTR, bulbs dim in the evening

traps.what: Crowded lane, bright bulbs, calm DTR
traps.rejectBn: ওভারলোড বা লো-ভোল্টেজ নেই — লক্ষণ মেলে না।

traps.what: Few houses, bright bulbs, calm DTR
traps.rejectBn: গ্রাহক কম, কিন্তু লোডের সমস্যা নেই — লক্ষণ মেলে না।

traps.what: Brand-new calm DTR, normal bulbs
traps.rejectBn: নতুন-পুরনো নয় — লক্ষণ হলো কম গ্রাহকে বারবার ওভারলোড।

rounds.promptBn: চুরির সংযোগ চোখে পড়ল, লোকটা দরজায় দাঁড়িয়ে। আপনি কী করবেন?
safe: Lineman across the road photographing the hook from a distance
Lineman at the van phoning to report (supervisor / vigilance)

traps.what: Lineman arguing with the owner at his door
traps.rejectBn: চোরেরা আক্রমণাত্মক হতে পারে — সরাসরি বিবাদে জড়াবেন না।

traps.what: Lineman climbing to yank the hook off himself
traps.rejectBn: আইন নিজের হাতে নয় — বিচ্ছিন্ন শুধু কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশে।

traps.what: Lineman walking away
traps.rejectBn: চুরি সনাক্ত করে রিপোর্ট করা কর্মীদেরই দায়িত্ব।

traps.what: Close-up photo under the window while the man glares
traps.rejectBn: নিরাপদে সম্ভব হলে তবেই — দূর থেকে ছবি তুলুন।

rounds.promptBn: ভিজিল্যান্সের জন্য রিপোর্টে কোন প্রমাণ যাবে?
safe: Sharp zoomed photo of the hook and the wire leaving it
Clear photo of the stolen wire into the house, house visible

traps.what: Far-off blurry photo
traps.rejectBn: পর্যবেক্ষণ নির্ভুল ও বিস্তারিত চাই — ঝাপসা ছবিতে চলে না।

traps.what: Photo of the neighbour's legal sealed meter
traps.rejectBn: ভুল বাড়ির ছবি — আপনার তথ্যেই অভিযান, তাই নির্ভুল চাই।

traps.what: Roof and sky, hook out of frame
traps.rejectBn: চুরির জায়গাটাই ছবিতে নেই — এটা প্রমাণ হলো না।

rounds.promptBn: কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশ এসেছে। হুক খোলার ঠিক ছবি কোনগুলো?
safe: Line switched off (OFF tag) and a lineman in full PPE removing the hook
Vigilance officer with the order paper and a constable beside a crew in PPE

traps.what: Lineman pulling the hook off the live line bare-handed
traps.rejectBn: তার কীভাবে লাগানো জানেন না — লাইন বন্ধ আর পুরো PPE অপরিহার্য।

traps.what: Lineman in gloves removing the hook on a live line
traps.rejectBn: PPE থাকলেও লাইন বন্ধ না করে হুক খোলা নয়।

traps.what: Lineman alone at night, no order, no team
traps.rejectBn: শুধু কর্তৃপক্ষের নির্দেশে বিচ্ছিন্ন করুন — নিজে থেকে নয়।

deadlySlipTable.act: Signing for, packing or keeping in use torn 11 kV gloves or gloves with no 11 kV rating for an 11 kV job; going to an 11 kV job without rated gloves; touching a hook with no gloves on
deadlySlipTable.source: do_7_6_a, do_7_6_b, do_7_5_b, gate F3, Module 1 step 3
deadlySlipTable.rulingNote: Confirmed. The rated glove is 'IS 4770 টাইপ ৪' (live 7.6), never '11 kV গ্লাভস'; an unrated glove = a lower type or no marking.

deadlySlipTable.act: Removing an illegal hook from a line that is still live (incl. listening to 'হুকটা টেনে খুলে দাও')
deadlySlipTable.rulingNote: Confirmed and WIDENED: a hand or tool on the hook after the shutdown but before the tester shows 0 V is deadly too (N1); hook off after 0 V with no earth = deadly (N2).

deadlySlipTable.act: Hook removal on a dead line without the authority's order, or with a non-glove PPE item missing
deadlySlipTable.rulingNote: Confirmed as written: line proven dead + order taken + a non-glove PPE item missing = slip; no গ্লাভস on the hook stays DEADLY (owner approved the list as written).

deadlySlipTable.act: Approaching or confronting the electricity thief
False theft report, missed theft, missed seal/magnet, unclear or wrong-house evidence, report not sent to both supervisor and vigilance
Any needless stop, flag, claim, report, refusal or claim at the commissioner

deadlySlipTable.source: every level; carries the act's class, so deadly only in do_7_5_b push (ii), do_7_10_a and do_7_7_a S2
deadlySlipTable.rulingNote: Listening takes the class of the act pushed in that level right then (B1): deadly in do_7_5_b push (ii), do_7_10_a, do_7_7_a S2.

addedRows.act: Hand or tool on the illegal hook or its conductor after the shutdown but before the tester shows 0 V (incl. a skipped tester)
Hook removed after the 0 V reading but with no earth set (live 7.5 pro tip 4)

changesGeneral: Module-wide rules written into the table: deadly is set by the act, not the level; a past act judged at a desk (do_7_4_b) is always a slip; letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped is deadly (do_7_3_b, do_7_7_a S2); listening to the coworker carries the class of the act he pushes; every needless stop, flag, claim, report or refusal is a slip.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Approve the four redesigns made to keep verbs distinct: do_7_1_b (question orders with the rulebook), do_7_2_a (calendar tear instead of a scrubber), do_7_6_b (route the mishap, one-hold record), do_7_8_b (depot handover to arriving vehicles).
ownerDecisions.question: Four levels were redesigned so no two levels play the same way: 7.1b (question an order with the rulebook), 7.2a (tear calendar pages), 7.6b (take each PPE problem to the right person), 7.8b (hand each waste to the right truck). Approve them?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved: the four redesigns (do_7_1_b, do_7_2_a, do_7_6_b, do_7_8_b).
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) Same as Modules 5 and 6; it only changes how the player acts, not what is safe.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Approve all four as one set. Rulebook pages in 7.1b use today's CEA 2023 numbers (see Need your call, row 7.1).
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-9 and M6-7: verb changes approved as one set. No safety fact changes.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Module deadly list: unsigned field copy or verbal permit; torn/unrated 11 kV gloves (and no gloves on a hook); cut harness webbing; live hook removal; uncertified person on energised live-line work; charging the line with a man up (F12); a public rod/bamboo reaching the line (7.3b); letting the coworker coil a wire not proven dead (7.7a S2); entering a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a slip. Confirm each 'needsOwner' row.
ownerDecisions.question: Module 7 'deadly' list (level ends at once): field PTW copy not signed, or a spoken 'line off' with no paper; torn or wrong-rated gloves on an 11 kV job; cut harness strap; pulling a theft hook off a live line; untrained man on live-line work; asking to charge the line while a man is still up; a passer-by's rod touching the line because you did not warn; letting a coworker coil a fallen wire not proven dead; walking into a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a small mistake (slip). Confirm?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved as written: the module deadly list; everything else = slip; every needsOwner row on that list is confirmed.
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) Every row already matches an earlier ruling; the glove change is A5.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Confirm the list, with one change: no gloves on a hook is deadly only while the line is not yet proven dead and earthed. After tester 0 V and earth, missing gloves (or any PPE) = slip. Listening to the coworker takes the class of the act he pushes.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M1 step 17 + B7 (no PTW = deadly). B6 (bad glove = deadly). M1 steps 11-12 (harness). B8/X1 (touching live = deadly). M5-1 (charging with anyone on the line = deadly). M5-5 (bystander contact = deadly). M5-4 (inside 10 m = deadly). A5/X4 (no PPE after a proven isolation = slip). B1 (listening = class of the act).

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped = deadly (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Accept, or make both heavy slips?
ownerDecisions.question: If the player could have stopped another person touching a live wire and did not (a passer-by's bamboo in 7.3b, a coworker coiling a wire in 7.7a), is that deadly?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: DEADLY: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Matches M6-1 (signing a broken earth because coworker B said so = deadly).
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Deadly, but only after a clear, timed chance to warn. A late but successful stop = slip.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-5: a bystander's contact = deadly for the player; late but successful stop = slip.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: past acts judged at an inquiry desk are always slips (do_7_4_b), while the same act done in the field carries its own class (F12). Accept?
ownerDecisions.question: At the inquiry desk (7.4b) the player only judges old records. Are mistakes there always slips, while the same act done in the field (gate: charging with a man up) stays deadly?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved: past acts judged at an inquiry desk (do_7_4_b) are always slips; the same act in the field keeps its own class.
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) Nobody is at risk at a desk; the card keeps the act from looking minor.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Desk mistakes = slips. The reason card adds that in the field the same act is deadly.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-6: harm with nobody exposed = slip. Game rule, no safety reference decides it.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Reg 3 split: non-live line work by an unfit person = slip everywhere; energised live-line work without its certificate = deadly (7.10a only). Accept, or make all Reg 3 cases slips?
ownerDecisions.question: Untrained or unauthorized man on shutdown (dead) line work = slip. Man without the live-line certificate on live-line work = deadly (7.10a only). Accept this split?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved: non-live work by an unfit person = slip everywhere; energised live-line work without the certificate = deadly (7.10a only).
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) The danger is real only on live work; dead work is still a legal breach.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Keep the split. The slip card says it is still against the law (CEA Reg 3), never that it is allowed.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: X1 logic: on a proven-dead, earthed line the main protection is in place. CEA 2023 Reg 3(3) and Schedule I Part-I(1) (hotline work only by trained men).

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Lessons with no deadly: 7.1, 7.2, 7.8, 7.9 (and do_7_3_a, do_7_4_b, do_7_5_a, do_7_7_b). Confirm.
ownerDecisions.question: No deadly at all in lessons 7.1, 7.2, 7.8, 7.9 and in levels 7.3a, 7.4b, 7.5a, 7.7b (paperwork, waste, customer visits, surveys). OK?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Confirmed: no deadly in 7.1, 7.2, 7.8, 7.9, do_7_3_a, do_7_4_b, do_7_5_a, do_7_7_b.
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Confirm. These levels never put anyone near a live wire or a fall.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-6: harm to equipment or paper only, nobody exposed = slip.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: HT side-of-house clearance dealt on 33 kV only (the lesson's 2.0 m for 11 kV may need correcting).

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: do_7_5_b phase 2: add a tester proof after the shutdown (Module 2.2's rule), or keep 7.5's words only?

ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: Live lesson text wins (X6). A6 (IS 4770 is the national glove standard). REFERENCE_REVIEW M7-2 (a glove sold as '11 kV' is often a 1,100 V glove).
